environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x on PHP-FPM 8.2 in a Kubernetes pod with a restrictive SecurityContext. The pod spec sets `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false` and drops ALL capabilities then adds back only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and a custom seccomp profile (based on RuntimeDefault) that additionally blocks the `shmget`, `shmat`, `shmdt`, and `shmctl` syscalls via an explicit SCMP_ACT_ERRNO filter. IPC namespace is private (default Kubernetes behavior). The PHP process runs as UID 1000 (www-data) with no supplemental groups. Note: CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN are explicitly dropped in the capability set, and the seccomp profile JSON is mounted from a ConfigMap at /etc/seccomp/session-replay.json.
